notes.title: EPISODE 2 - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://gallery.mailchimp.com/1405e12bf069c975aa6f35df4/images/aae59626-ba86-45ee-9f7f-c4887129333e.jpg

Digital Tribe Games, and German Indie Developer Michael Lückgen, are excited to bring the second episode of the Return Null trilogy to Steam today.
 
ReturnːnullːNULL – Episode 2 picks up after the climatic events of Episode 1. Jack Drebin ːdrebinː is back as he continues to pieceːgetː together the mysteryːmagnifyː around the dramatic events that threw his life into turmoil and the powerful movement to overthrow the oppressive regime that infests his life and the lives of those around him. Society’s downtrodden have had enough. People in the Lower City seek justice, equality and freedom. It will take nothing short of a revolution will make difference.

https://youtu.be/-Rg7C_JyPIQ

The Return NULL series is a trilogy of Point & Click Adventures created in an indie comic art style. Set in a distant dystopian society under an oppressive force players take on the role of Jack Drebin, an LSF Officer whose life spins out of control when he gets caught up in something much bigger than himself. Episode 1 introduces characters and a plot that escalates into an intense finale.  Episode 2 begins right where episode 1 ends and expands on the story while introducing new key characters and delving deeper into the plot. Stay tuned to digitaltribegames.com for upcoming information on Episode 3.
 
Examine environments for clues, carry on dynamic conversations, collect items and solve logical environmental puzzles to advance through the twisting narrative. When the action gets hot, Return NULL incorporates a real-time duck and cover shoot out mechanic that elevates the tension.  
 
FEATURES INCLUDE

• Reads the save file from Episode 1 to determine where you begin in Episode 2
• Unique characters, each with different emotional dialogue portraits
• Interactive hand drawn locations
• Unique indie comic art style
• Original composed music tracks that set the mood and tone of each scene
• Innovative, real-time gunplay mechanic
• Available in English & German

Return NULL - Episode 2 is DLC and requires the ownership of the original Return NULL – Episode 1 to be playable. Both are available now on Steam separately, or in a bundle, for Windows PC, Mac and Linux platforms. Return NULL – Episode 2 has a suggested retail price of $2.99 USD. A -33% limited time discount will be available during launch.

notes.title: A Peak Behind the Scenes
notes.content:
http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/RN1-ConceptUpdate-Banner.jpg

See your game udpating? Wondering what it is? It's a visual behind the scenes look at some of the environmental concept art, original notes and character concepts for Return NULL. This Conceptual Update is full of sketches, lighting tests and progression art. The easiest way to access this new content:


   Open up your Steam Client
   Right-Click on Return NULL - Episode 1 in the library
   Select PROPERTIES
   Click on the LOCAL FILES tab
   Click on BROWSE LOCAL FILES
   Open the CONCEPT file


Enjoy this closer look at the making of Return NULL - Episode 1 and get ready for Episode 2, coming soon!

http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/MichaelLuckgen.png
